title: ADJ Core
description: Tweaks and changes made for my modpack 'A Distant Journey' which I couldn't find existing mods for.
body:
Tweaks and changes made for my upcoming modpack 'A Distant Journey' which I couldn't find existing mods for.

  Those include (but are not limited to):

*   Porting the mod [Auditory](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/auditory) (with some changes here and there).
*   Nerfing Bows.
*   Reducing max levels of vanilla enchantments.
*   Adding a Campfire regeneration buff (there were mods for those but I wanted to add a custom effect for it).
*   Removing invincibility frames from attacks (or capping them at a different amount that vanilla's 10).
*   Reducing taken knockback.
*   Making players have built-in Fortune I and Unbreaking I on everything (without actually having the enchantments).
*   Nerfing the Speed, Strength and Weakness effects (or in case of Weakness - straight up reworking it).
*   Changing the duration and amplifier of potions effects granted by potions (unsure if it supports modded potions :P).
*   Nerfing the Resistance effect's damage reduction.
*   Buffing the Conduit.
*   Disabling critical hits and sweep attacks (doesn't disable sweeping visuals and sounds).
*   Making it unable to equip 2 of the same Curios.
*   Removing every Curio slot type except one (selectable).
*   Adding Curio exclusion groups using datapacks.

You are free to use this mod in your modpack, however:

*   Please do not ask me for ports to different versions. It was made SPECIFICALLY for my 1.20.1 modpack.
*   Please do not report bugs with different mods. It was only tested for compatibility with mods used in the ADJ modpack. Bug reports will be ignored.
*   Most of the changes aren't configurable or aren't togglable. Don't ask me to add configs for those.
